rules: Achilles: eccentric heel drops every leg day (3 × 15, slow). No running until cleared. No heavy calf raises.
Knees: leg extension light only. No deep squats, lunges, heavy leg press, jump squats or hip thrusts.
Core is optional every session. Sore: skip it and add an extra arm exercise under Bonus.
No legs this week: swap Thursday to the Saturday session (Push + Pull + Arms + Core).
